verdict.rationale: The only evidence on this story is a hands-on community report (penpot-comm-5) that Penpot could export individual layers. The same user could not export the whole design as a single PDF or JPG, and no first-party export documentation is in the pack. Missing for 10: first-party docs on export formats (PNG/SVG/PDF and more), per-layer export presets, scale multipliers, slices, multi-board or whole-file PDF export, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a designer, I can export production assets — PNG, SVG, PDF, and more — with per-layer presets, scales, and slices

citations.quote: I could only export a layer.
